title: clausena pentaphylla
intro: Clausena pentaphylla, commonly known as Taiwan yuzu or five-leafed Clausena, is a plant species native to southern China and Taiwan, belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clausena pentaphylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which may contribute to its use in treating fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Clausena pentaphylla include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
